# Skillomate

> Skillomate is an online learning platform for practical AI, content, business, and digital skills through short, expert-led courses.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://skillomate.in/): Browse featured lessons and learning paths.
- [Courses](https://skillomate.in/courses): Explore the available course catalogue.
- [Pricing](https://skillomate.in/pricing): Review current plans and access options.
- [About](https://skillomate.in/about): Learn about Skillomate and its teaching approach.
- [Help](https://skillomate.in/help): Find support information and common answers.
- [Contact](https://skillomate.in/contact): Contact the Skillomate team.
